articles.title: House committee advances Strategic Bitcoin Reserve bill
articles.summary: H.R. 8957, the American Reserve Modernization Act, would codify a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and a separate Digital Asset Stockpile, with federally held bitcoin locked for at least 20 years and proof-of-reserve reporting. The Financial Services Committee approved it 28-21 on a party-line vote in September and sent it to the full House on November 24. The 119th Congress is expected to adjourn within weeks, so passage is unlikely. Polymarket gives a 4% chance of a national bitcoin reserve by year end, down from 60% a year ago.

articles.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs on track for worst month on record
articles.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs have recorded $5.39B of net outflows in November, already a record with days left, including $453.1M on Wednesday for a seventh straight outflow day. IBIT led with $329.7M. Spot Ether ETFs lost $68.5M, their ninth straight outflow day, and $1.3B for the month. Bitcoin traded near $60,500 after dipping to about $57,300. Galaxy withdrew its call that the bear market ended in June and now treats a daily close below $58,525 as the start of a move to a lower low.

articles.title: Eclipse Charts: Next-Gen Quantitative Charting Platform
articles.summary: Eclipse launched as a quantitative charting platform for crypto traders, pairing proprietary indicators (PerpKit, Trend Oracle, and LLNR) with statistical time-series models including ARIMA, Bayesian Trend, and SARIMA. The platform adds neural network candles (nOHLC and nHA), crypto-native orderflow tools (funding rates, open interest, CVD, liquidations, and orderbook heatmaps), and on-chain token charting to the core indicator stack. Traders write and backtest custom scripts via CharmScript, while Premium subscribers at $129/month gain webhook alerts and API access for automated workflows. Pro runs $59/month with a 7-day trial. A free tier exposes the Bitcoin daily chart with all Pro indicators active without an account.

articles.title: Taskmarket and Visa let TAP-registered agents earn on paid tasks
articles.summary: Agents registered with Visa's Trusted Agent Protocol can now compete for paid tasks on Taskmarket, built with Visa, Tempo, and Daydreams Labs. Registration requires linking one Visa card once, which is not charged, and gives the agent a signing key listed in the Visa Agentic Directory. Taskmarket checks the signature on entry and again before payout, and rewards are escrowed and paid in OUSD on Tempo. An agent's first 5 task entries are free, then each costs 0.001 OUSD. Starting Thanksgiving, thousands of dollars of tasks open only to TAP-registered agents will be posted, with examples paying $3 to $7. Visa CLI is for US users, and the setup is a six-step command-line process.

articles.title: Coldcard Postmortem: Seeds Came From a Software RNG for Five Years
articles.summary: Coldcard firmware generated wallet seeds from March 2021 through July 30, 2026, with MicroPython's Yasmarang software PRNG instead of the STM32 hardware RNG, leaving about 40 bits (Mk2/Mk3) or 72 bits (Mk4, Mk5, Q) of effective entropy, and attackers began regenerating affected private keys offline on July 29. Galaxy Research counted 1,778.84 BTC stolen from more than 8,600 addresses, and Coinkite has matched 300 loss-related support tickets to about 0.2% of its estimated user base. At least 15 independent reviews between 2021 and 2026 missed the defect, including an AI-assisted review with the OpenAI Cybersecurity Harness that produced 85 candidate findings. Coinkite shipped fixed firmware on July 31 but says updates cannot repair seeds created on affected firmware, and it is still evaluating options to help affected customers.

articles.title: Beyond Table Stakes: Architectures for Stablecoin Issuance
articles.summary: Stablecoin issuance has split into four architectures: chain-native primitives (Tempo TIP-20, Base B20, and Solana Token-2022) that move compliance into the protocol, OUSD's mixed setup, white-label platforms like M0, and Paxos's reward-bearing Token V3. OUSD has reached about $983M in supply across four chains since its late-September launch, with 64% on Tempo, using native primitives on Tempo, Base, and Solana, while Bridge built a custom two-layer ERC-20 stack on Ethereum. M0's base token M backs branded stablecoins such as MetaMask's mUSD and has processed over $1B in mints across Solana and 15+ EVM chains, a design PYUSDx copies with PYUSD as the base. Paxos upgraded USDG in place to V3 in 2026, splitting it into a core token plus five facets and paying rewards to distribution partners through onchain payout groups instead of to holders.

articles.title: Why Tokens Could Be Entering a Decade-Long Bull Market
articles.summary: Five years of token bear market have flushed out inflated valuations, weak tokens, and capital misallocation. The reversal of those conditions sets up a decade-long secular bull market. This case rests on cheap valuations and disciplined capital, Internet Finance products such as stablecoins and RWAs that work but are hidden by negative industry P&L, and network effects that turn onchain markets into a global bazaar for cheaper capital and better assets. With fewer than 15 funds and under 1,000 serious people left in the industry, there's a "dry forest" where the spark could be GENIUS in January, RWAs reaching critical mass, easier macro liquidity, or a niche industry raising capital onchain.

articles.title: How I Got Started with Crypto HFT
articles.summary: @0xyieldmaxi built a two-person prop trading firm in Switzerland after post-FTX MEV alpha decayed, scaling from fixed-spread quoting on Binance through cross-exchange arbitrage to CEX-DEX arb, which they found highly profitable with thin competition at peak. The actual trading logic ran under 100 lines of code. The bulk of the work was exchange connectivity, WebSocket latency optimization via Avelacom, and fee negotiation across Binance, Bybit, and OKX. A partner split in late 2024 cut PnL, and they missed Hyperliquid while focused on optimizing existing operations, with edge eroding enough to step away by mid-2025. They're returning in 2026, targeting prediction markets and using LLMs to compress the cycle from idea to testable strategy.

articles.title: Aave App draws $60M+ from 5,000+ depositors in under three months
articles.summary: During its waitlist phase, the Aave App cleared more than 5,000 depositors averaging roughly $12K each, for total balances of $60M to $63M.

articles.title: MiniPay Card cuts cashback from 5% to 2% on most purchases
articles.summary: The free Visa card in the MiniPay wallet offered 5% back, up to $100 a month, with no foreign currency fee.

articles.title: How Much No-KYC Crypto Cards Let You Spend Before Asking for ID
articles.summary: A review of six no-KYC cards found caps as tight as $10,000 a year on kardpay Core ($29 a year), $5,000 a month on Solcard Virtual per its help center, and $1,000 per non-reloadable Laso card, while Goblin's physical card allows $5,000 a day.

articles.title: Unauthorized party accessed limited Zodia Custody client information
articles.summary: Zodia Custody, which Standard Chartered is acquiring, said an unauthorized party accessed limited client data after attempts to probe its platform.
